name: NecroCode Agent Execution Hooks
description: Trigger hooks that fire on visual agent stage transitions in the NecroCode Visual Agent Studio. These map 1:1 to the WORKFLOW_STAGES in lib/types.ts and drive the canvas node highlighting, neon trails, and terminal SFX. Each hook declares the target stage, the agent phase it corresponds to, and the visual/audio effect to apply.

hooks.name: on-run-start
hooks.description: Fires when the user clicks 'Run Agent Exorcism'. Resets the canvas to Idle and opens the SSE stream.

hooks.name: on-input-parsing
hooks.description: Highlights the Input Parsing node with a pulsing border and emits a node-activate blip.

hooks.name: on-context-scanning
hooks.description: Highlights the Context Scanning node and streams a neon trail from the previous node (Scanning state).

hooks.name: on-kiro-hook-trigger
hooks.description: Highlights the Kiro Hook Trigger node and streams a neon trail to the next node (Processing state).

hooks.name: on-code-generation
hooks.description: Highlights the Code Generation node while synthesized code streams into the terminal.

hooks.name: on-run-complete
hooks.description: Fires when the workflow reaches Complete. Marks all nodes done and plays the completion chord.
